interval_years.quote: The division shall issue each license and permit under this chapter in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by division rule.

period_years.quote: During each two-year licensure cycle or other cycle defined by rule, a licensee under this chapter shall complete qualified continuing professional education requirements

available.quote: An applicant for licensure as a dentist qualifying under the endorsement provision of Section 58-1-302 shall: (a) be currently licensed in good standing with an unrestricted license in another jurisdiction described in Section 58-1-302; (b) document having met all requirements for licensure under Subsection (1) except Subsection (1)(c); and (c) document having been successfully engaged in clinical practice as a dentist for not less than 6,000 hours in the five years immediately preceding the date of application for licensure in Utah.
available.citation: Section 302 - Qualifications -- Licensure as a dentist -- Licensure as a dental hygienist. (Effective 5/7/2025)

requirements.value: Applicant must be currently licensed in good standing in another jurisdiction, meet all licensure requirements except the CODA degree requirement, and document 6,000 hours of clinical practice in the five years preceding application.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing or engaging in, representing oneself to be practicing or engaging in, or attempting to practice or engage in any profession requiring licensure under this title ... if the person is: (i) not licensed to do so or not exempted from licensure under this title; or (ii) restricted from doing so by a suspended, revoked, restricted, temporary, probationary, or inactive license
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 501

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct as defined by statute or rule

disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee is unable to practice the occupation or profession with reasonable skill and safety because of illness, drunkenness, excessive use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or other type of material, or as a result of a mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 401

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a license or passing an examination through fraud, forgery, or intentional deception
disciplinary_grounds.quote: obtaining a passing score on a licensure examination, applying for or obtaining a license, or otherwise dealing with the division or a licensing board through the use of fraud, forgery, or intentional deception, misrepresentation, misstatement, or omission
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 501

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sharing professional fees with an unlicensed person or paying for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: sharing professional fees with an unlicensed person or paying any person for sending or referring a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making unsubstantiated claims of superiority in training, skill, or professional services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: making an unsubstantiated claim of superiority in training or skill as a dentist or dental hygienist or in the performance of professional services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing authorized agents of the division or health authorities access to facilities for inspection
disciplinary_grounds.quote: refusing authorized agents of the division or state or local health authorities access to the facilities related to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene during normal business hours for the purpose of inspection

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain facilities, instruments, equipment, and supplies in a sanitary condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to maintain facilities, instruments, equipment, supplies, appliances, or other property or conditions related to the practice of dentistry in a sanitary condition consistent with the standards and ethics of the professions of dentistry or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely making or altering a medical record with intent to conceal wrongful conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: falsely making an entry in, or altering, a medical record with the intent to conceal: (i) a wrongful or negligent act or omission of an individual licensed under this chapter or an individual under the direction or control of an individual licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering anesthesia or analgesia without holding a current permit from the division
disciplinary_grounds.quote: administering anesthesia or analgesia in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene if the individual does not hold a current permit issued by the division authorizing that individual to administer the type of anesthesia or analgesia used

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directing or interfering with a licensed dentist's judgment and competent practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: directing or interfering with a licensed dentist's judgment and competent practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.quote: advertising or otherwise holding oneself out to the public as practicing a dental specialty in which the dentist has not successfully completed the education specified for the dental specialty as defined by the American Dental Association

definition_quote.value: Practice of dentistry means offering, undertaking, or representing to examine, evaluate, diagnose, treat, operate, or prescribe therapy for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or any other condition of the human teeth, alveolar process, gums, jaws, or adjacent hard and soft tissues and structures in the maxillofacial region; administering anesthetics; administering and prescribing drugs; supervising dental hygienists and assistants; and representing oneself as a dentist.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of dentistry" means the following, regarding humans: (a) to offer, undertake, or represent that a person will undertake by any means or method, including teledentistry, to: (i) examine, evaluate, diagnose, treat, operate, or prescribe therapy for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or any other condition of the human teeth, alveolar process, gums, jaws, or adjacent hard and soft tissues and structures in the maxillofacial region

value: oral appliance therapy for sleep-disordered breathing
supervision of dental hygienists and dental assistants
methods_authorized.quote: to offer, undertake, or represent that a person will undertake by any means or method, including teledentistry, to: (i) examine, evaluate, diagnose, treat, operate, or prescribe therapy for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or any other condition of the human teeth, alveolar process, gums, jaws, or adjacent hard and soft tissues and structures in the maxillofacial region

drug_authority.value: Dentists may administer and prescribe drugs related to and appropriate in the practice of dentistry; anesthetics require a permit from the division; may prescribe or dispense opiate antagonists under specified conditions.
drug_authority.quote: to administer and prescribe drugs related to and appropriate in the practice of dentistry

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: The division in collaboration with the board shall establish by rule: (a) the classifications of anesthesia and analgesia permits; (b) the scope of practice permitted under each permit classification; and (c) the requirements for obtaining each class of permit.
sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.citation: Section 301 - License required -- License classifications -- Anesthesia and analgesia permits. (Effective 5/7/2025)

specialist_license_available.quote: advertising or otherwise holding oneself out to the public as practicing a dental specialty in which the dentist has not successfully completed the education specified for the dental specialty as defined by the American Dental Association

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: does not include a dentist who advertises as being qualified in a recognized specialty area of dental practice so long as each such advertisement, regardless of form, contains a prominent disclaimer that the dentist is licensed as a general dentist or that the specialty services will be provided by a general dentist

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means the supervising dentist is present and available for face-to-face communication with the person being supervised when and where professional services are being provided. ... "General supervision" means that the supervising dentist is available for consultation regarding work the supervising dentist has authorized, without regard as to whether the supervising dentist is located on the same premises as the person being supervised. ... "Indirect supervision" means that the supervising dentist is present within the facility in which the person being supervised is providing services and is available to provide immediate face-to-face communication with the person being supervised.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: Notwithstanding Subsection (1) and except as provided in Subsection (2), a dental hygienist may engage in the practice of dental hygiene without general supervision if: (a) the dental hygienist engages in the practice of dental hygiene in a public health setting

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: a dental hygienist may engage in the practice of dental hygiene without general supervision if: (a) the dental hygienist engages in the practice of dental hygiene in a public health setting; (b) prior to engaging in the practice of dental hygiene in a public health setting, the dental hygienist notifies the division on a one-time basis

value: individuals in a public health setting
assisted living or long-term care facility residents
patients of mobile dental health programs employing a licensed dentist
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: "Public health setting" means: (a) an individual's residence, if the individual is non-ambulatory; (b) a school, as part of a school-based program; (c) a nursing home; (d) an assisted living or long-term care facility; (e) a community health center; (f) if a dental hygienist is employed by a public health agency, a location directed by the public health agency; (g) a federally-qualified health center; or (h) a mobile dental health program that employs a dentist who is licensed under this chapter.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Regardless of the form in which a licensee engages in the practice of dentistry, the licensee may not permit another person who is not licensed in Utah as a dentist and is not otherwise competent to engage in the practice of dentistry to direct, or in any other way participate in, or interfere in the licensee's practice of dentistry.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: an individual performing mechanical work on inert matter in a laboratory pursuant to a written prescription from a licensed dentist may engage in acts and practices included in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene without being licensed under this chapter

teledentistry_authorized.quote: "Teledentistry" means the practice of dentistry using synchronous or asynchronous technology.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: under the general supervision of a dentist: (i) administer local anesthesia

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: under the indirect supervision of a dentist: (i) administer nitrous oxide analgesia

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: The division shall create certifications for dental auxiliaries to perform, under the indirect supervision of a dentist, various expanded functions, including: ... (b) placement of direct restorations by a dental hygienist certified by the division or a dental assistant certified by the division
restorative_function_endorsement_availab.citation: Section 808 - Expanded functions of dental auxiliaries. (Effective 5/7/2025)

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: a dental hygienist may engage in the practice of dental hygiene without general supervision if: (a) the dental hygienist engages in the practice of dental hygiene in a public health setting; (b) prior to engaging in the practice of dental hygiene in a public health setting, the dental hygienist notifies the division on a one-time basis
